# Pride Of Detroit

> > Pride Of Detroit is a comprehensive Detroit Lions fan community covering news, analysis, draft coverage, and team history.

This site provides in-depth coverage of the Detroit Lions NFL franchise, featuring game analysis, player profiles, draft scouting, roster moves, and historical archives. The community focuses on players like Matthew Stafford and Calvin Johnson, while tracking current roster developments and prospect evaluations.

## Key Topics

- Detroit Lions
- Matthew Stafford
- Calvin Johnson
- NFL Draft coverage
- Draft watch and scouting
- Injury reports
- Roster moves
- Free agency
- Player signings
- Game analysis
- Lions news
- Practice updates
- College football prospects
- Team history
- Player performance analysis

## Historical Archives

- [Detroit Lions Notes Archive for October 2009](https://www.prideofdetroit.com/archives/detroit-lions-notes/2009/10): October 2009 archive of Lions notes on injuries, roster moves & practice
- [Detroit Lions Draft Archive for October 2015](https://www.prideofdetroit.com/archives/detroit-lions-draft/2015/10): October 2015 archive of Lions draft coverage and college football scouting
- [Detroit Lions News Archive for March 2008](https://www.prideofdetroit.com/archives/detroit-lions-news/2008/3): March 2008 archive of Lions news covering free agency and offseason moves
- [Detroit Lions Analysis Archive for November 2012](https://www.prideofdetroit.com/archives/detroit-lions-analysis/2012/11): November 2012 archive of Lions analysis, game reviews & player performance
